**Main line:** bxc3+ Kb3 cxd2 (winning the rook)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is driven to the side of the board by checks or forcing moves, look for undefended pieces it was protecting. Here, the pawn on c3 gave check to the king on b2 while simultaneously attacking the rook on d2 behind it—a classic royal fork. The key insight: forcing moves (checks and captures) create tactical opportunities by removing the king's ability to defend material. Always scan the board after checks to spot undefended pieces the king was guarding.
